parameters.name: X-Setup-Code
parameters.description:
The one-time setup code the server prints in its log on first start
(also stored in `<DATA_DIR>/secrets/setup_code`). Case, spaces and
dashes are ignored. Required on every first-run route, so reaching a
fresh server is not enough to take it over; a missing or wrong code
is `403` with `code: setupCodeInvalid`. Deleted once setup succeeds.
